$comment: CN-016 — what the smoke test opens after every deploy and every night (tools/smoke.mjs). storefront: every built storefront page, opened signed out like a customer; each PR that builds a storefront page adds it here. The admin pages are found from the admin menu after sign-in. ignoreRequests: request paths whose failure is known and owned by a register PR, each with the PR that removes it; keep this list short. ~~/favicon.ico until PR 501~~: it always answers now (the owner's brand.favicon, else a neutral bag icon). discover (PR 49): pages found on a built page, opened like the listed ones: the first product pages New in links to (the products are the owner's, so none is named here; a shop with no product yet opens none). checks: extra checks after the pages, signed in, once — a page element's value (page, selector, attribute, equals) or a request's answer (request, status), each with the PR it guards. figures (PR 155, CN-022): admin pages that show the one KPI pair, opened signed in on each screen; each selector must match exactly one element with a label and a figure (`value`, default b), and the labels must differ, so Sales (delivered orders only) and Ordered value stay separate figures. The admin dashboard joins this list when it shows them.
